name: SOC Detection Lab - Coverage Map
description: Techniques investigated in Splunk (Lab 1) and covered by custom Sigma rules tested with Chainsaw (Lab 2). Green = custom detection rule written and fired on sample data. Blue = observed/hunted in logs, no custom rule yet.

techniques.comment: Rule: Windows System Event Log Cleared (Event 104) fired on PC01.example.corp. Event 1102 (Security log cleared by user01) confirmed in Splunk and via Chainsaw search. Sigma rules: win_system_log_cleared.yml, win_security_log_cleared.yml.
Rule: New Service Installed On System (Event 7045) fired 3 times: spoolfool, spoolsv, remotesvc. Noisy by design; tuned variant checks ImagePath for shells/scripts.
Rule: Member Added To Local Administrators Group (Event 4732) fired 2 times on MSEDGEWIN10. Guest (RID 501) and Network Service (S-1-5-20) added by IEUser.
Observed in Splunk/Chainsaw: services spoolfool and spoolsv with ImagePath cmd.exe running as LocalSystem. Change to green once the suspicious-ImagePath rule is confirmed firing.
Observed: service named spoolsv imitates the legitimate Print Spooler service name (spoolsv.exe).
Hunted in Splunk (Linux_2k.log): 490 failed SSH logins from 47 sources; top source 150.183.249.110 with 80 attempts.
